caption: The drawing depicts a pair of scissors positioned diagonally across the center of a blank, light beige background. The scissors have two metal blades with a metallic gray sheen, and the handles are rounded and also metallic, rendered in dark gray or black. The handles are shown with circular finger holes at the top. Attached to the scissors, near the pivot, is a curved, brownish metallic component. The composition centers the scissors with significant empty space around them, and the only visible text is located in the bottom right corner, consisting of a small, handwritten signature and the date "1941."
title: Wick Trimmer
